text: Shree Balaji Steel Traders Pvt Ltd (V001) freight charges are approved by the team when they are ₹5,000 or less per trip, regardless of whether AP agents like Precedent recommend holding or approving the invoice.
Shree Balaji Steel Traders Pvt Ltd (V001) has a standing agreement limit of ₹5,000.00 for freight charges per trip; charges exceeding this amount are not on the purchase order and require a hold.
